Tests gRPC HTTP/2 request header generation and HPACK encoding.

# Purpose
This file is a small C test program for `fd_grpc_h2_gen_request_hdrs`, which builds HTTP/2 request headers for gRPC calls. It creates two `fd_grpc_req_hdrs_t` inputs, one without authentication and one with a bearer token, then encodes the headers into an `fd_h2_rbuf_t` buffer. The test uses `fd_hpack_rd` to decode the generated HPACK data and checks that the expected pseudo headers and gRPC headers are present, including `:method`, `:scheme`, `:path`, `:authority`, `te`, `content-type`, `user-agent`, and, when set, `authorization`. The [`main`](<#main>) function starts the Firedancer runtime, runs the test, prints `pass`, and stops the process.
